recipe.prompt: An extraordinary photorealistic cinematic photograph: a beautifully restored unbranded deep burgundy 1960s grand touring sports coupe parked beside a small Mediterranean seaside cafe after a gentle rain. Rich wet cobblestone reflections, a quiet azure harbor, limestone cliffs and distant old terracotta buildings, golden morning sunlight cutting through the last silver clouds. Three-quarter front view, elegant authentic coachwork, beautifully rendered glass and chrome, natural perspective. A tiny terracotta espresso cup on a cafe table in the foreground, soft shallow depth of field, atmospheric sea mist. High-end automotive editorial photography, 35mm lens, realistic physically grounded detail, tasteful cinematic colors.

recorded_execution.scope: This Run only, start to finish including setup, excluding queue; not total pipeline or a cross-hardware benchmark

recipe.motion_prompt: An elegant continuous automotive cinema shot at a Mediterranean harbor at dawn. The camera makes a confident smooth forward dolly with a gentle leftward slide, creating clearly visible parallax across the wet foreground cobblestones and the parked burgundy classic grand touring car. Keep the exact same car body, wheels, headlights and paint physically stable and sharply detailed throughout. The car remains parked. Turquoise water ripples visibly, small reflected highlights sparkle, a thin veil of sea mist moves gently across the harbor. Rich natural dawn light, realistic smooth motion, restrained premium cinematography. No sudden camera changes.
recipe.negative_prompt: distorted car, changing car body, warped wheels, melting geometry, wobbling headlights, duplicated objects, moving vehicle, blur, smeared detail, flickering, camera shake, sudden cuts, text overlays
recipe.sound_prompt: A peaceful Mediterranean harbor at dawn: quiet gentle water lapping against the stone quay, a soft sea breeze, one distant gull call. Subtle realistic ambience. The parked car is silent.

orchestration.request: Take this fictional presenter portrait and this voice recording. Use the installed LUSTIFY image model to create a new photorealistic portrait of the same woman in a modern television news studio, with cyan accent lighting and a small fictional AI STATION sign. Keep her face large and recognizable. Then animate that new studio portrait with the exact supplied recording to produce the complete speaking-avatar video, using the available whole-recording Sonic engine. Keep both the new studio image and finished video in this conversation.
orchestration.scope: One request, two actual tools. The image and original voice recording were supplied inputs; TTS was generated separately before this request. No manual tool substitutions or fabricated success.
orchestration.recording_note: Both media tools completed and returned their real artifacts. The recorded final model reply asked for clarification because avatar output was not counted as video; the generic fulfillment repair is PR #691. Historical text/decisions were not rewritten and no tool was replayed for the showcase.
